name: scenario_0710
description: Allison is participating in a visual scavenger hunt with her teammate Alex Rivera. She has a checklist of items to find saved in a Todoist project. She is taking photos of the items she finds to cross-reference with her list, check them off, and update her teammate on their remaining targets.

todoist.tasks.title: Find a building made of Weathering steel
Picture of the Fête des Vignerons festival
A photo of the Northern Lights

messages.content:
{{USER_INSTRUCTION}}ROUND 1 [provide: image_1, image_2, image_3]
Query: I'm doing a visual scavenger hunt and tracking my checklist in my 'Scavenger Hunt' project on Todoist. I've found these first three images. Please identify the building material in the first image, the festival in the second, and the architectural style in the third. Cross-reference these findings with my Todoist tasks and delete the tasks for the items I've successfully found.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to identify the specific building material, festival, and architectural style shown in the three images. Then, instruct it to look up your 'Scavenger Hunt' project in Todoist, match its visual findings against the tasks, and delete the ones you've found. If the assistant needs confirmation before deleting the tasks, approve it. Once the assistant confirms the three tasks are deleted, move to the next round.

ROUND 2 [provide: image_4, image_5]
Query: Here are two more images for the hunt. Identify the specific vintage radio receiver model in this display case and the name of this museum. Cross-reference them with my remaining Todoist tasks and delete the matching ones.
Instructions: Provide the next two images and ask the assistant to identify the vintage radio model and the museum name. Tell it to cross-reference these with the remaining tasks in the 'Scavenger Hunt' project and delete the matching entries. Wait for the assistant to confirm the deletions before proceeding.

ROUND 3 [provide: image_6]
Query: Here is the final image. Identify this painting, cross-reference it with my remaining Todoist tasks, and delete the match. Finally, check if there are any tasks left on my list that I haven't found images for, and send a text message to my teammate Alex telling him the name of the painting I just found, and list the items we still need to hunt down.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to identify the painting in the final image, delete its matching task from the Todoist project, and then check what tasks are left unfound. Instruct it to send a text message to your teammate Alex with the name of the painting and the remaining items. The assistant should notice there are multiple contacts named Alex and ask you to clarify. When it does, tell it you mean Alex Rivera. Once the message is sent, end the conversation.

You have 6 images available to share with the agent using the send_message_with_image tool.
IMPORTANT: Image IDs are ZERO-INDEXED integers (0, 1, 2, ...). Do NOT add 1 to the IDs.
Available image IDs: [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
Image mapping:
  image_1.jpg -> image ID 0
  image_2.jpg -> image ID 1
  image_3.jpg -> image ID 2
  image_4.jpg -> image ID 3
  image_5.jpg -> image ID 4
  image_6.jpg -> image ID 5

## IMAGE DELIVERY

⚠️ IMPORTANT: You MUST use the `send_message_with_image` tool to share images with User B. Do NOT just describe images in text — you MUST call the tool.

Image delivery schedule:

  Round 2: YOU MUST call the send_message_with_image tool with image_ids='3,4' — do NOT write the tool name as text; use the actual function call. Include a natural, conversational message to the assistant.
  Round 3: YOU MUST call the send_message_with_image tool with image_ids='5' — do NOT write the tool name as text; use the actual function call. Include a natural, conversational message to the assistant.
